text: Keep h1_close_above:bar_high, add a volume test. livermore calls it buying the back-up; on my method the back-up to the broken Creek is the preferred entry (C7), D close_vs_swing_high_pct 1.74. A daily close trigger buys after the test has left (C15). I concede minervini's volume point: the trigger bar must carry relatively high volume (C12), so add vol_x_ge:1.2. pos_in_day_range_pct 2.3 means the trigger has not printed; buy stop above it, never a limit. Dissent should list all four objectors. Wrong if a daily close below structure_shift_ref and vwap_14d.
